section.title: Preview before edit
section.subtitle: See which lines change before a file is written or edited
field.enabled.label: Enable preview before edit
field.enabled.help: When off, no diff is posted into the conversation; tools still run and approvals are still asked.
field.maxLines.label: Lines shown per preview
field.maxLines.help: Anything past this many lines is not shown; the end states how many lines are left (default {lines}).
field.contextLines.label: Context lines around each change
field.contextLines.help: Same idea as -U in `diff -u`: 0 shows only the change itself, 3 is the default. Those context lines are what tell you which function changed.
field.chain.label: Where it sits in the chain
field.chain.text: order 25: earlier than the approval card (30), so you already see what will change before you click Allow; it never blocks and never clears other guards (it always defers).
field.stats.label: This mount's counter
field.stats.text: {emitted} previews sent, {truncated} of them cut off by the line limit.
